title: Stunning Leader
caption: Stunning Leader (V)
game_text: Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) a Mistryl. OR If your Mistryl present during battle, use 1 Force to reveal the top three cards of opponent’s Reserve Deck. Add the destiny number of the highest-destiny male revealed (if any) to your total power. Replace revealed cards.
lore: Stormtroopers are trained to stun, not kill, priority targets in order to split enemy forces and hold the leaders for interrogation. Stun effects wear off, requiring efficient action.

notes: Group: Mistryl. Not unique. Bottom-half slip, banner USED INTERRUPT (printed: LOST INTERRUPT). The slip prints ▼ (down triangle) before '(or retrieve)'; the stub expands it as 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle' (the ▲ expansion) while its note says 'Down-triangle' — the slip clearly shows ▼ (zoomed). Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. The default wiki 'Stunning Leader' page = the Original face. Scans: ANH-D-stunningleader-decipher-archive.gif is a 367×506 photo of the printed card (used only to read lore/copyright); ANH-D-stunningleader.gif (350×490) is the PC ERRATA face ('E', text 'If a battle was just initiated…') — same art, used as art.src for art only. Lore matches the printed card. Copyright ANH 1996 by rule. Modern: VB4-D-stunningleader-pre.gif (same text).
